> 第116章 婚礼惊变（第1页）
轿外，喜乐震天，散修与各方势力的贺喜声此起彼伏。
然而落在陈凡耳中，这些声音却平添了几分森然的死气。
随着喜娘一声尖锐的高喊，轿帘被掀开。
“今天本店开业有优惠，头十位做美容的顾客可以享受九折优惠，名额有限，大家抓紧哪！”李雨桐再次呼喊道。
结果自然是悲剧的，虽然轩辕天赋隐隐压了蚩尤一筹，但是毕竟还处在黄级三阶的修为上，光是蚩尤就把他打得狼狈而逃了，何况还有九黎部落那么多血脉战士。
刚才李真说他自已是医生，福伯也有点相信，毕竟，功夫到了这种境界，身上肯定还有其他的绝技，或绝妙医术，或奇门八卦等等异能。
何老爷子此时也很开心，不是说秦家阵营多了一位悍将，而是多年未见的母子终于重逢，无尽的母子思念也终于有了一个结果。
这份积分兑换列表是李煜让红后刚刚制作出来的，里面按照武器、药品、生活物资等分门别类记录了目前地下基地内几乎所有物资以及兑换需要的积分。
士可忍熟不可忍，叔可忍婶都不想忍了，寿宁候一把掀了李吏的炉子，然后忿忿的指着李吏。
每一处血管都在强化，每一处骨骼都在固话，就连骨髓与血液都在深深的发生改变。
之前盏蒙被华生斩杀的时候，枯镜并不在，不然的话，绝对不会坐视华生任意妄为，说起实力，枯镜比盏蒙要强上不少，而且修炼的也不是冥蛟族的功法，而是自己的功法。
“本宫明白。”苏修容拍了拍青葵的手，表示自己知道应该怎么做。
“怎么样，是放我走还是让我带着她一起死？”黎川痞笑道，好像吃定了萧砚会妥协一样。
船客以为薛氏不能接受孩子死了的事实，怜悯地看着她，摇摇头。
腰部断裂，张海燕一屁股坐在了地上，但那尸体却还在继续的收缩着。
剩下的男人不是去作坊帮忙，就是在家收拾房子，这次甭管房子有没有塌，村长都不让村民住进去，强制要求大家拆了危房，重建屋子，钱不够就到江宁那边赊账，以后慢慢还。
他们不相信，但云深说得煞有介事，而且他从不会跟他们开这种玩笑，关键是他们都在这，云深也骗不了他们。
跟着医生火急火燎地冲到病房，帮主此时已经在往外倒气，就是出气多入气少的意思。

接着房间中的画面在金光当中消失，眼前则是出现了连绵的白雪皑皑的山脉。
此话深深刺激到了白芷，她也意识到了自己的失态，转过身，捋了捋方才发生的一切。
除了衣服，江宁还让下人给他们做了羊皮靴子，用的是羊皮袄子的边角料，穿这样一套出门，零下二三十度都不觉得冷。
随后我在黄勇跟几位理事的带领下，来到祠堂后院，供奉着祖师爷的庙宇。
片刻，虚空中荡漾开一道门户，慕云烟那清丽的倩影缓缓走了出来。
他们夫妻认真的讨论起点心的事情来，把赵四丢在那里不管不顾。赵四知道这是淑沅和金承业故意的，但现在距天明只有一个多时辰，他的时间真得不多了，哪里能不心焦？

> Chapter 116 A surprise at the wedding (page 1)
Outside the sedan, the joy was overwhelming, and congratulations from the cultivators and various forces came and went.
However, in Chen Fan's ears, these sounds added a bit of a dead air.
With a sharp shout from Xi Niang, the sedan curtain was opened.
"There is a discount for the opening of our store today. The first ten customers who get beauty treatments can enjoy a 10% discount. The number of places is limited, so hurry up!" Li Yutong shouted again.
The result was naturally tragic. Although Xuanyuan's talent was slightly superior to Chi You's, he was still at the third level of yellow level cultivation. Chi You alone beat him into a panic and fled, not to mention there were so many bloodline warriors from the Jiuli tribe.
Just now, Li Zhen said that he was a doctor, and Uncle Fu also believed it. After all, if his kung fu reaches this level, he must have other special skills, wonderful medical skills, strange sects, gossip, etc.
Mr. He was also very happy at this time. It was not that the Qin family had a strong general, but that the mother and son who had not seen each other for many years were finally reunited, and the endless longing for mother and son finally came to an end.
This points redemption list was just made by Li Yu and the Red Queen. It records almost all the materials currently in the underground base and the points needed for redemption according to categories such as weapons, medicines, and daily necessities.
Shi Ke couldn't bear it, and his uncle and aunt didn't want to bear it anymore. Shouninghou turned off Li Li's stove and pointed at Li Li angrily.
Every blood vessel is strengthening, every bone is being strengthened, and even the bone marrow and blood are undergoing profound changes.
When Zhan Meng was killed by Watson, Ku Jing was not there. Otherwise, he would never sit back and let Watson do whatever he wanted. Speaking of strength, Ku Jing was much stronger than Zhan Meng, and he was not practicing the techniques of the Ming Jiao Clan, but his own techniques.
"I understand." Su Xiurong patted Qing Kui's hand, indicating that she knew what to do.
"What do you think, should you let me go or let me take her to death with you?" Li Chuanpi said with a smile, as if he was certain that Xiao Yan would compromise.
The boatman thought that Mrs. Xue could not accept the fact that the child was dead, so he looked at her with pity and shook his head.
With her waist broken, Zhang Haiyan sat down on the ground, but the body continued to shrink.
The remaining men were either helping in the workshops or cleaning up the houses at home. Regardless of whether the houses collapsed or not, the village chief refused to let the villagers live in them. He forced everyone to demolish the dilapidated houses and rebuild them. If they didn't have enough money, they would go to Jiangning on credit and pay them back slowly in the future.
They didn't believe it, but Yun Shen was serious about what he said, and he would never make such a joke with them. The key was that they were all here, and Yun Shen couldn't deceive them.
Following the doctor, he rushed to the ward in a hurry. At this time, the gang leader was already breathing out, which means more air coming out and less air coming in.
Then the scene in the room disappeared in the golden light, and the continuous snow-capped mountains appeared in front of him.
These words deeply stimulated Bai Zhi. She also realized her gaffe, turned around, and reviewed everything that had just happened.
In addition to clothes, Jiang Ning also asked his servants to make sheepskin boots for them, using scraps from sheepskin jackets. Wearing such a set when going out, they would not feel cold at 20 to 30 degrees below zero.
Then, led by Huang Yong and several directors, I went to the backyard of the ancestral hall, where the temple is dedicated to the ancestor.
After a moment, a portal opened in the void, and Mu Yunyan's beautiful figure slowly walked out.
The couple discussed the starting point seriously and left Zhao Si there without caring. Zhao Si knew that this was intentional by Shu Yuan and Jin Chengye, but now there was only more than an hour before dawn, and he really didn't have much time. How could he not be anxious?
